title: Mini Lazarillo: Edición mínima del Lazarillo de Tormes
author: Anonymous
institution: Department of Latin American and Iberian Cultures, Columbia University (Susanna Allés Torrent and students)
notes: Student digital edition of the 1554 Medina del Campo printing of the Vida de Lazarillo de Tormes, in a plain reading edition and an annotated edition, with images of the original volume. The text follows that printing but modernises spelling and accents (see the editorial criteria page), so it is a modernised edition, not a diplomatic transcription. A TEI master file is in the GitHub repository. The counts cover the TEI master text (prologue and seven tratados), keeping the original readings where the file encodes them. The repository was last updated on 4 May 2020. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
